verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state individual subscribers can opt out of data being used for AI model training, directly matching the engineering-lead's ask, but the evidence doesn't clarify org/enterprise-level opt-out controls or admin enforcement, and community discussion (e.g., verbatim code recitation) raises residual data-handling concerns not fully resolved by docs. Missing for 10: explicit org/enterprise-admin opt-out policy details, independent audit confirming opt-out is honored, and clarity on default settings for business/enterprise tiers.
